name: Remove Windows bloatware
description: Uninstall preinstalled consumer apps (Spotify, Candy Crush, TikTok…).
does: Removes provisioned AppX packages for common bloatware apps.
revert: Reinstall via Microsoft Store, or re-register the package.

name: Disable telemetry & diagnostics
description: Turns off Windows data collection services.
does: Disables DiagTrack and dmwappushservice services and sets the telemetry policy to Security/0.
revert: Set services back to Automatic and remove the registry policy key.
script:
Stop-Service DiagTrack -Force; Set-Service DiagTrack -StartupType Disabled
Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:SOFTWAREPoliciesMicrosoftWindowsDataCollection' -Name 'AllowTelemetry' -Value 0 -Type DWord -Force

name: Disable Recall
description: Removes the Windows Recall screenshot history feature.
does: Disables the Recall optional feature via DISM.
revert: Enable the feature again: Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName Recall.

name: Restore classic right-click menu
description: Brings back the full Windows 10 context menu on Windows 11.
does: Adds a registry key that restores the legacy context menu.

name: Enable Ultimate Performance power plan
description: Unlocks the hidden high-performance power plan.
does: Duplicates the Ultimate Performance power scheme and activates it.
revert: Switch back to Balanced in Power settings.

name: Remove snapd
does: Purges snapd, removes snap directories, and masks apt reinstallation.
revert: Reinstall snapd: sudo apt install snapd; remove the nosnap preference file.
script:
sudo apt purge -y snapd || sudo dnf remove -y snapd || sudo pacman -Rns --noconfirm snapd || true
rm -rf ~/snap /var/snap /var/lib/snapd

name: Set up Flatpak + Flathub
description: Installs Flatpak and adds the Flathub remote.
does: Installs flatpak via the native PM and adds flathub remote.
revert: Remove flatpak package and its remote.
script:
if command -v apt-get >/dev/null; then sudo apt install -y flatpak; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null; then sudo dnf install -y flatpak; else sudo pacman -S --noconfirm flatpak; fi
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists flathub https://flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo

name: Install multimedia codecs
description: Adds restricted/extra codecs for video & audio playback.
does: Installs ubuntu-restricted-extras / gstreamer codecs / ffmpeg per distro.
revert: Remove the packages shown in your distro's PM.
script: if command -v apt-get >/dev/null; then sudo apt install -y ubuntu-restricted-extras ffmpeg; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null; then sudo dnf install -y ffmpeg gstreamer1-plugins-good gstreamer1-plugins-bad; else sudo pacman -S --noconfirm ffmpeg gst-plugins-good gst-plugins-bad; fi

name: Fix fractional scaling blur
description: Enables fractional scaling in X11 sessions.
does: Enables the x11 fractional-scale-scaling experimental setting via gsettings.
revert: Set the key back to 'scale-monitor-framebuffer' or remove the override.

name: Lower swappiness
description: Reduces how aggressively the kernel swaps to disk.
does: Writes vm.swappiness=10 to /etc/sysctl.d/99-swappiness.conf and reloads sysctl.
revert: Delete the file and run sudo sysctl --system.
